datasets.name: Open Scriptures Hebrew Bible (Hebrew + Aramaic morphology)
datasets.coverage: All 39 protocanonical Old Testament books (Hebrew narrative + Aramaic portions in Daniel/Ezra, distinguished per-token by the morph-code language prefix H=Hebrew, A=Aramaic)
datasets.morphologyLemmaStrongs: Open Scriptures Hebrew Bible morphology project
datasets.licenseText: See data/original-language/hebrew-aramaic/raw/ — LICENSE fetched from https://github.com/openscriptures/morphhb/blob/master/LICENSE.md. Attribution required: "Original work of the Open Scriptures Hebrew Bible available at https://github.com/openscriptures/morphhb".
datasets.format: OSIS XML, one file per book, <w lemma="..." morph="...">surface</w> per word
datasets.notInScope: VerseMap.xml (verse-numbering crosswalk, not linguistic data — not imported)

datasets.name: Nestle 1904 Greek New Testament with morphology, lemmatization, and Strong's numbers
datasets.baseText: Eberhard Nestle's 1904 Greek New Testament (public domain; text-critical edition now over a century old)
datasets.morphologyLemmaStrongs: Dr. Ulrik Sandborg-Petersen (Scripture Systems, Denmark), building on Dr. Maurice A. Robinson's morphological databases
datasets.licenseText: See data/original-language/greek/raw/Nestle1904-morph-README.md — full text waived under CC0 by biblicalhumanities.org.
datasets.format: TSV, one row per word: BCV, text, func_morph, form_morph, strongs, lemma, normalized

rejectedAlternative.reason: The SBLGNT base text itself is distributed under the SBLGNT EULA (http://sblgnt.com/license/), which restricts commercial redistribution and republication rights. Given uncertainty about BibleBuddy Enterprise's production/commercial rights under that EULA, this batch did not import the SBLGNT text and used the CC0 Nestle 1904 edition instead, which carries no such restriction.

datasets.name: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance — Hebrew/Aramaic Dictionary (1894), digitized
datasets.license: CC BY-SA (per in-file header comment: "Copyright 2010, Open Scriptures. CC-BY-SA. Derived from XML."). No standalone LICENSE.md file exists in the source repository at the time of this fetch; this citation is the file's own header, preserved verbatim as provenance.
datasets.format: CommonJS module exporting an object keyed by Strong's number, fields: lemma, xlit, pron, derivation, strongs_def, kjv_def

datasets.name: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance — Greek Dictionary (1890), digitized
datasets.license: CC BY-SA (per in-file header comment: "Copyright 2009, Open Scriptures. CC-BY-SA. Derived from XML.").
datasets.format: CommonJS module exporting an object keyed by Strong's number, fields: lemma, translit, derivation, strongs_def, kjv_def

governanceNotes: No dataset in this import was AI-generated. All lemma, morphology, Strong's-number, and gloss data trace to the named human scholarly sources above.

The Latin Vulgate was NOT imported in this batch (no validated open dataset located under the time available); it remains a documented gap, not a fabricated substitute. See docs/alpha/phase6-knowledge-<timestamp>/ report for this blocker.
The Septuagint (LXX) was NOT imported in this batch for the same reason and is documented as a gap, not fabricated.

services/originalLanguageProvider.js is the only production consumer of these files. It never calls an LLM to invent tokens, lemmas, morphology, or Strong's numbers — only to phrase an already source-grounded explanation, and only where implemented.
